subject: Total reward summary for L4 Backend hire - margin impact
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New L4 Backend candidate — request for signoff on pay mix and margin

Sofia / Markus —

Priya Rao (linked below) is our top choice for the L4 Backend role. Before we send the formal offer I ran the numbers on total cost and margin impact for FY27. Key points: 

- Base: $160,000
- Target bonus (OTI): 12% of base ($19,200)
- Equity: 8,000 RSUs over 4 years (standard L4 grant)
- Benefits + payroll tax add ~12% to cash cost

Attached is the total_reward_model_v3.xlsx with line-item P&L for the hire and an alternate scenario with a slightly lower base + higher equity (if we want to preserve margin). Two asks: 

1) Quick signoff on the proposed mix so People Ops can prepare the offer letter we plan to send early next week.
2) If you prefer the alt scenario (lower base by $8k + +2k RSUs), tell me and I will route the updated numbers for approval.

Related links: Greenhouse app and the draft offer (attached).

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Head of Infrastructure Hiring
Redwood Inference

Attachments: total_reward_model_v3.xlsx, offer_letter_draft_priya_v2.pdf

> Priya Rao (linked below) is our top choice for the L4 Backend role. Before we send the formal offer I ran the numbers on total cost and margin impact for FY27. Key points: 

Thanks Laura — the model looks reasonable overall. Two quick notes from my side: 

- Can we keep base at $158k and bump equity to 9k RSUs? That keeps near-term cash down but keeps total comp competitive against market comps I pulled.
- Please add a 6-month pro-rata vesting clarification line in the offer letter for new managers joining mid-quarter.

I attached a one-page snapshot (approval_snapshot_markus.pdf) with the recommended pay mix and my verbal signoff pending Karthik/Finance OK on the payroll bucket.

Thanks both — quick responses: 

- I prefer the lower cash + higher equity approach Markus suggested (base $158k, 9k RSUs). That preserves FY27 operating margin and gives the candidate upside.
- Karthik — can People Ops confirm payroll/tax impact and that this still fits the L4 band? If yes, I'll approve the draft and we can proceed to extend the offer.

Laura — please swap to the adjusted numbers in the attached offer letter draft and run the final through Comp Ops. I will be available for a short thumbs-up after lunch.
